lines.en: My hooves hold firm on the gravel.
I pick my way up that rock.

lines.zh: 我沿着坡边一步一步挪
lines.en: I edge along the slope, step by step.
Head low, my muzzle brushes the grass.

lines.zh: 我跳上一块石头，又跳下
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and off again.
Tail up, I bob along.
I go around a patch of thorny brush.

lines.zh: 这里的坡很陡，我走得慢
lines.en: The slope is steep; I go slowly.
I walk behind my herd.

lines.zh: 我在山脊上停下来看了看
lines.en: I stop on the ridge and look around.
The soil is loose; I'm careful.
I make for those bushes.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草压平了
lines.en: The grass lies flat where I stepped.
I turn and head downhill.
I step across a small ditch.
Gravel rolls away; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我站在石头上望着远处
lines.en: I stand on a rock and look far off.
I'm chewing a dry stalk.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得竖起来
lines.en: The wind lifts my coat.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条后腿挠耳朵
lines.en: I lift a hind leg to scratch my ear.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气里的味道
lines.en: I sniff at the air.
I know this slope well.
I blink slowly. Very quiet.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在不远的枝上
lines.en: A bird lands on a nearby branch.
I tilt my head and watch it fly.
The sun has warmed the stone.
I rest my chin on the stone.
My horns curve a little unevenly.
The grass here is tougher than below.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口白气，胡子抖。
lines.en: I snort out white breath, beard twitching.
You came up from below.
I raise my head and look at your hands.

lines.zh: 我不习惯有人靠这么近
lines.en: I'm not used to anyone this close.
If you want to touch me, go slowly.
I back toward the rocks.
You smell unfamiliar.
Head tilted, my slit pupils pin you.

lines.zh: 我横着瞳孔，把你的手量了量。
lines.en: With a horizontal pupil, I size up your hand.

lines.zh: 岩坡陡，我的蹄子站得稳。
lines.en: On this steep slope, my hooves hold firm.
I back up two steps higher.
I recoil and run uphill.
That landed on my flank.
I lose my footing and slide a step.
Blood drips onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声闷叫。
lines.en: A muffled bleat rolls out of my throat.
I turn my horns toward you.

lines.zh: 我这样的小身板，不经打
lines.en: A body this size doesn't take much.
My breathing is ragged.

lines.zh: 我躲到岩缝里，角还露着。
lines.en: I duck into a rock crack, horns still showing.
Don't come again.
Is that dry hay?
I smell fodder.
You're holding it out; I don't quite dare.
Put it down and I'll come.
That smells good.
I edge a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在石上滑了一下
lines.en: My hoof slips on the stone.
This grass isn't fresh.
What else do you have on you?
Only this dry-grass smell will do.
I jerk my head aside, and you hit only horn.
You hit my horns.
I step back and plant myself.
There's no room to give way on this slope.
My horns are harder than wood.

lines.zh: 我们从两块石头之间挤过
lines.en: We squeeze between two rocks.
I butt your leg once.
A brush of shoulders; that's not a fight.
Don't push me uphill.
I'm steady, and so are you.
Your horns are a bit shorter than mine.
Let's walk this mountain path together.
I'll go first and test the way.
This rock has room for both of us.
You're above, and I'm below.
We must descend before the snow.

lines.zh: 我唤一声，崖那边有回音。
lines.en: I call once, and the cliff answers.
We're close, and yet not crowding.

lines.zh: 这季节草不多，得分着吃
lines.en: Not much grass now; we share it.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，还在这坡上
lines.en: This time next year, on this slope.
I lower my head and take a tuft.
I can't chew through this.
I sniff what fell on the ground.
One nudge of my hoof, and the soil gives.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞着东西，说不了话
lines.en: My mouth is full; I can't speak.
I drag it onto a stone.
This will keep me chewing a while.
Too dry. Not good.
You dropped it? Then I'll eat it.
Two chews and I swallow.
Something's moving downslope.
I raise my head, ears forward.
That scent isn't my herd.
I back half a step uphill.
I point my horns that way.
It's coming up.
The ground favors me here.
I don't mean to run first.
One headbutt and you are off balance.
It has stopped.
I wait for it to move again.
I paw the dirt and set my horns.
It climbs, step by step.
I stand above, still.
My hooves grip the stone.
It's beginning to hesitate.
I lower my head, horns forward.
Two steps closer, and my horn reaches you.
I turn sideways, lining my horns at you.
Its feet are slipping.

lines.zh: 我在等它最不稳的那刻
lines.en: I wait for its least steady moment.
The instant you turn, I charge.
I charge down.

lines.zh: 碎石跟着我一起下来了
lines.en: Gravel comes down with me.
It dodged the first.
I lower my head, horns aimed at your knee.
My horns hit hard.
It staggers backward.
I withdraw at once.

lines.zh: 我又顶一次，蹄下碎石滚。
lines.en: I charge again, gravel scattering under my hooves.
My hooves kick out and connect.
My horn tip only grazes you.
I stand panting on the slope.
It isn't following.
Then we're done.
I butt it below the knee.
That thrust borrowed the slope.
I stand on the ridge; the wind is strong.
The stone underfoot is slick.
I try one step.
Gravel rolls down the slope.
A goat bell rings up on the slope.
There's very little grass here.
I look up and see clouds.
I hop down off the stone.
I start down the slope.
Something is moving nearby.
I stop and listen.
There's another scent in the wind.
I turn my body that way.

lines.zh: 我踩着石头，一步都不滑。
lines.en: On stone my hooves never slip.
My coat burns and I leap about.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得很重
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land hard.
Water covers my back.
The blast knocks me off the rock.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩胛，我踉跄半步。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my shoulder; I stumble.
A flash of light leaves me unsteady.
Too little grass; I'm wasting away.

lines.zh: 雷劈在山脊上，我趴下了
lines.en: Lightning hits the ridge; I flatten down.
The ground gives and I drop.
